- Sunstone’s site names Lennar, Shea Homes, Woodside Homes, and Richmond American Homes, about 3,650 homes, parks, trails, and an age-qualified neighborhood. Retrieved 2026-10-12. https://sunstonelv.com/
- Shea labels Trilogy Sunstone 55+ and priced it from $399,990 on 2026-10-12. https://www.sheahomes.com/new-homes/nevada/las-vegas-area/las-vegas/trilogy-sunstone

- Homes.com Sunstone local guide, retrieved 2026-10-13, lists ZIPs 89143 and 89166, Trilogy as 55+, builders from Lennar to Woodside, Sun Trails Park, Sun Mountain Park, the Nature Paseo, a mountain bike trail around the Moccasin Walking Trail, and Alyn Beck Memorial Park. The page does not date its $561,604 average value, $269 per square foot, or 105-home count. It says “over 3,000” planned homes; sunstonelv.com says about 3,650. Its airport drive time (about 30 minutes) disagrees with the September 30, 2026 measurement of about 49 minutes. https://www.homes.com/local-guide/las-vegas-nv/sunstone-neighborhood/
